description:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.




YOUR ROLE

Be at the forefront of bringing agentic AI to procurement: automating intake, accelerating approvals, and transforming how enterprises manage spend and vendor decisions at scale.

As an AI FDE, you will partner closely with a small group of enterprise customers to design, build, and deliver high-quality AI agents and AI based products that automate complex procurement workflows. You'll make those first customers successful, turn what works into a repeatable playbook, and train our Solutions Consultants to scale the deployment to the rest of our customers.

This is a high-impact role ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of customer engagement, solution design, and AI-driven product development.

This track is for procurement leaders who have led sourcing, contracting, intake and approvals, the work our agents automate, and want to shape how AI does it. You don't need to code. You'll work alongside our engineers to turn your procurement judgment into agents customers trust.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design & Build AI Agents & AI Based Products: Work hand-in-hand with customers to understand procurement workflows and develop AI agents & AI based products that solve their most critical pain points.

 - Plan and Scope Deployments: Set the scope, success criteria and project plan with the initial launch customers before kickoff, then own time to value through go-live.

 - Own the Quality Bar: Write the requirements, test cases and evals, and hold the line on accuracy and reliability before an agent goes live.

 - Feedback Loop into Product: Turn what you learn in the field into requirements and priorities for engineering and product, and guide the roadmap for our AI agent platform.

 - Build the Playbook: Turn what works into a repeatable playbook and train our Solutions Consultants to scale the deployment to more customers.

 - Bring the Procurement Lens: Turn sourcing, contracting and approval best practice into agent skills, policies and test cases, and judge agent output the way a procurement leader would.




YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE

 - Thrive in high intensity environments where change and iteration are key to success

 - 4+ years of in-house procurement experience, including implementing procurement tools (ie. Coupa, Ariba etc.)

 - Ownership of a spend portfolio, with software and services deals you negotiated end to end

 - A procurement workflow you designed in a P2P tool, such as intake or PR-to-PO

 - Daily use of AI tools in your own sourcing or contracting work

 - A track record of taking projects from plan to production: setting scope, success criteria and timelines, and delivering against them

 - Experience writing requirements and partnering with engineering and design to ship products

 - A track record of influencing cross-functional partners and leadership without direct authority

 - Ability to prioritize ruthlessly, even if it may disappoint customers or stakeholders

 - Strong written and verbal communication with internal and external stakeholders, including executives

 - Extreme attention to detail, with the ability to quickly grasp complex business processes and industry knowledge

 - Deep technical curiosity with ability to understand and influence how AI agents & AI based products are built, tested, and improved

 - Bonus: Experience with agent-building tools (e.g., n8n, Glean) or familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol)

 - Bonus: Contracting and risk reviews for AI vendors, or SOX and audit controls work

 - Bonus: Org-wide training you built and delivered

 - Bonus: Product management experience, or past roles where you worked with end customers to influence software development

 - Bonus: Python or SQL scripting experience



The salary range for this role is  $130,000- $170,000 OTE. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.




PERKS & BENEFITS

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

 - 📈 Start-up equity

 - 🦷 100% health, vision & dental coverage options

 - 🍽️ Catered breakfast, lunch, & dinner

 - 🌴 Flexible PTO

 - 🏋️‍♀️ ClassPass membership

 - 🚍 Monthly commuter benefit

 - 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

 - 💻 Home office stipend

 - 🛜 Phone/internet reimbursement

 - 🍼 Paid parental leave

 - 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Fertility stipend

 - 💸 401k plan

 - 🤖 AI token usage
   

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!
